The '''Dentarian Ripple''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] with a strong odor<ref name="GH" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Dentaria system/Legends|Dentaria system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Dentari sector/Legends|Dentari sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It had an intoxicating effect on members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GH" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Gaartatha's companion|partner]] of the Wookiee<ref name="GH" /> freelance [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|305|Gaartatha}}</ref> [[Gaartatha]] was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Slaver/Legends|press gang]]. While Gaartatha was subsequently looking for possible help in rescuing his companion,<ref name="GH" /> he consoled himself<ref name="CSWE" /> by indulging in alcoholic beverages at a [[Unidentified cantina (Stannik Nhaa)|cantina]] that catered to members of various species, where he imbibed several Dentarian Ripples.<ref name="GH" />

{{RPGseed}}
At one point, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Stannik Nhaa]], who was looking for a way to travel off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] hosting the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], entered the establishment in search of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[D'Voras Brin]]. Nhaa encountered Gaartatha lurking near the cantina's door and noticed him smelling of the consumed Dentarian Ripples, deciding to avoid the drunken Wookiee.<ref name="GH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Dentarian Ripple was introduced in ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, the beverage was mentioned in an example gameplay passage that illustrated the possible description of characters controlled by the gamemaster player.<ref name="GH" /> The inclusion of<ref name="CSWE" /> the part of<ref name="GH" /> the scene mentioning the Dentarian Ripple in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' rendered its existence fully [[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends continuity]],<ref name="CSWE" /> and this article assumes the entire scenario plays out as described.<ref name="GH" />
